stories.headline: 'Top Chef' Eric Adjepong Allegedly Violated Ex-Wife's Restraining Order Before Daughter's Protective Order - TMZ
stories.summary: "Top Chef" star Eric Adjepong allegedly violated a restraining order against his ex-wife, Janell Mack, more than a year before his daughter obtained a protective order against him ... TMZ has learned.
stories.why: A high-profile celebrity's domestic violence allegations expose how fame insulates men from accountability, making this a reckoning moment for how you evaluate people you've been rooting for.

stories.headline: Ryan Reynolds Thanks 'Deadpool' Fans After Undercover Comic-Con Visit - Deadline
stories.summary: With Deadpool regenerating for a fourth blockbuster outing, Ryan Reynolds is already getting back into character as the wisecracking mercenary.
stories.why: Reynolds' Deadpool momentum signals superhero fatigue is fake—irreverent, self-aware comedy still sells massive blockbusters, defining what studios greenlighting next.

stories.headline: Nickelodeon child actor crashes out, reveals bleak reality of residual checks from sitcom - Fox News
stories.summary: Jennifer Hyatt Tedmori opened her stack of residual checks from "Ned's Declassified School Survival Guide" on video, revealing shockingly low payouts.
stories.why: A child actor exposing residual check poverty exposes the exploitative economics of entertainment that make child stardom a financial trap, not the generational lottery it appears to be.
